pages.title: Stack City
pages.creator: Pelican Party Studios
pages.description:
Stack City combines city building with merging on a grid. Start by placing scaffolding and shops, then combine structures to build upward and increase the money your city earns. Invest that income in extra building space so you can continue expanding.

Placement matters because certain grid spaces accept buildings of a particular color. You need to consider both where a structure fits and how it contributes to further growth. Developing taller buildings and opening more space work together, giving you a city to shape through a repeating cycle of placement, merging, and reinvestment.

pages.title: FlakWing
pages.creator: NA
pages.description: Fly through 18 missions in FlakWing, a vertical shooter that takes you over islands, deserts, and frozen mountains. Dodge fire, rescue stranded pilots, and collect stars to upgrade six aircraft systems. Work up through the difficulty levels or try Daily Sortie and Endless Survival for a different challenge.

pages.title: Scraps!
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Place hexagonal tiles in Scraps! and connect matching colors to score. Level up a color to earn a merge power-up. The pieces you place stay on the board, so leave yourself room to work. The run ends when there’s nowhere to fit another piece.

pages.title: Ambidieztro
pages.creator: Jhampier
pages.description: Move two characters at once in Ambidieztro, using a separate set of controls for each hand. Look at the paths on both sides and plan how to bring the characters together. They have to touch before you can move on to the next coordination challenge.

pages.title: Happy Egg Catch
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Watch the eggs swing overhead in Happy Egg Catch. Tap to let one drop when its path lines up with the basket below. The basket moves between rounds, so adjust when you release to keep your catching streak going.

pages.title: Paper Wars: Battles and Upgrades
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Choose your troops and aim at the opposing side in Paper Wars: Battles and Upgrades. Fight across a sheet of paper against a friend or the computer. Unlock new fighters and improve your attacks as you build a lineup for the next battle.

pages.title: Paws Off My Clues!
pages.creator: H5 Games
pages.description: Search scenes full of cats in Paws Off My Clues! Look for hidden objects on sunny beaches, among Persian ruins, and in other locations. Check around the cats and their belongings for clues, then work through the puzzles to move on to another scene.

pages.title: From Nerd to Popular Ballerina Cappuccina
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style Ballerina Cappuccina as she prepares for the stage in From Nerd to Popular Ballerina Cappuccina. Choose an outfit, hairstyle, and accessories for each stage of her story. Watch how her look changes as she grows more confident and gets closer to performing.

pages.title: Enchanted Easter Adventure
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Join Lily and a bunny for an Easter celebration in Enchanted Easter Adventure. Follow their springtime story and work through small puzzles as new activities appear. Try the dress-up options along the way and put together a look for the holiday.

pages.title: Cube Stack 2048
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Collect numbered cubes in Cube Stack 2048 and combine equal values to double them. Steer past obstacles and pick up money while you build your stack. Try to reach 2048 or higher before the end of the course, then take on another layout.

pages.title: Sprunki PopIt
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pop every bubble in the level in Sprunki PopIt. Look at where the obstacles are before you start and keep checking for bubbles you haven’t reached. Clear the current layout to move on to another set of bubbles and obstacles.

pages.title: 100 Hidden Capybaras
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Find 100 capybaras across the scenes in 100 Hidden Capybaras. Search forests and villages, then look through dungeons and unfamiliar planets for the rest. Check the small details in each picture, where a capybara can blend into the scenery.

pages.title: Secrets of Charmland
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Swap sweets to make matches in Secrets of Charmland. Help Emma fill requests for her friends and meet new characters as you travel through Charmland. Use boosters and set up combinations to clear trickier boards and finish the quests you find along the way.

pages.title: Walkers Attack
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Move through zombie-infested areas in Walkers Attack. Your weapon fires automatically, so focus on finding a safe route, gathering resources, and completing missions. Unlock new settings as you progress, from medieval areas to city streets and science-fiction levels.

pages.title: Shape Transform Race
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Switch vehicles to suit the terrain in Shape Transform Race. Watch what kind of surface is coming and change before you reach it so you can stay ahead. Race computer opponents or a friend, and spend the coins you earn on vehicles and characters.

pages.title: Quest by Country
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Identify countries by their flags in Quest by Country. Look closely at the colors, shapes, and emblems before choosing an answer. Pay attention to small differences between similar designs as you work through flags from around the world.

pages.title: Finger Heart Monster Refill
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Fit a small monster against a hand to make a heart in Finger Heart Monster Refill. Look at the empty part of the outline and decide which shape the monster should take. Try a different pose if the curves don’t line up with the fingers.

pages.title: Easter Eggventure
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Hunt for Easter eggs in the spring scenes of Easter Eggventure. Scan the picture for eggs tucked among the other details and select each one you find. Keep searching until you’ve collected the full set and can move on to another scene.

pages.title: Angry Plants Flower
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Use plants and fruit to defend the kingdom in Angry Plants Flower. Set up your defenses to stop monsters and zombies as they come toward you. Watch where the attackers are gathering and choose what to place so they don’t get through.

pages.title: Kiddie Farmers
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Run a farm-to-table market in Kiddie Farmers. Make products and sell them to other kids, then decide how to grow the shop as more customers arrive. Keep the market supplied as you expand beyond what you could produce at the start.

pages.title: Skibidi Hit Master
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Fight invading toilets as a cameraman in Skibidi Hit Master. Aim at groups of enemies and work your way through the attacks. Take on the Skibidi Boss and G-Man as you try to stop their army from taking over.

pages.title: Smile Style
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Recreate one of six emoji looks in Smile Style. Choose makeup and accessories to bring out an expression, whether it’s in love, angelic, devilish, cool, sad, or angry. Compare the finished look with the emoji and try a different expression on the next character.

pages.title: Dino: Merge and Fight
pages.creator: Lipsar Studio LLC
pages.description: Combine warriors and tame dinosaurs in Dino: Merge and Fight. Build up the army before sending it against enemy fortifications, and use merges to strengthen your forces for later fights. Watch how your lineup handles a battle before making the next change.

pages.title: Summer Celebrity Fashion Battle
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Put together looks for Kylie Jenner, Kendall Jenner, and Gigi Hadid in Summer Celebrity Fashion Battle. Try bright colors and bold combinations inspired by the spring and summer collection. Finish each outfit with accessories that give the three looks their own style.

pages.title: Winter Fairy
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style a fairy in a snowy forest in Winter Fairy. Browse outfits and shoes in white and different shades of blue, then choose a hairstyle and frosty makeup. Try the pieces together to see how your choices look against the winter setting.

pages.title: Crazy shooting
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Aim at the bricks in Crazy shooting and look for a shot that reaches more than one. Check where the bricks are before firing and watch for ones that contain items. Use what you uncover to help clear the blocks that remain.

pages.title: Mahjong 3D Connect
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Find matching tiles in Mahjong 3D Connect. Rotate the stack to see what’s available on its other sides, then select pairs that can be connected. Clearing a pair opens up more choices, so keep looking around the structure until you’ve removed the tiles.

pages.title: Virile Grandpa Escape
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description: Search a village for clues in Virile Grandpa Escape. Check the objects and details around the palace and use what you find to solve the puzzles. Work out where the villagers are holding Grandpa and find a way to free him.

pages.title: BFF Fairytale Makeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give Emma and Mia storybook looks in BFF Fairytale Makeover. Pick their makeup first, then look for fairy-tale outfits and accessories to go with it. Try different pieces for each friend so both princess looks have details of their own.

pages.title: Protect My Dog
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Draw a barrier to protect the dog in Protect My Dog. Look at where the bees can reach and keep the dog away from hazards such as lava or thorns. Work through 50 puzzles, changing your drawing as each layout gives the bees another way in.

pages.title: Real Sports Flying Car 3d
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Switch from driving to flying in Real Sports Flying Car 3d. Take the car along the ground or activate flight to climb into the air. Turn flying off midair when you want to try a jump or flip, then work on bringing the vehicle back down.

pages.title: Shadow Fighters: Hero Duel
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Choose one of eight fighters in Shadow Fighters: Hero Duel. Battle in different locations and work through the opponents in Story Mode. Play on your own or bring in another player for a duel and see how your chosen fighter handles each matchup.

pages.title: PEN BOY RUNNER
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: Run with a pencil in PEN BOY RUNNER and try to reach the finish before its ink runs out. Watch for obstacles and aim to arrive with extra ink for a better reward. Unlock hats and skins to change how the pencil looks on later runs.

pages.title: Burger Mania
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Run a burger counter and build each customer's order from the ingredients in front of you. Check the pictured burger, then stack the toppings in the same order. Keep an eye on the clock as you put together each meal and move on to the next customer.

pages.title: Pin Spin !
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Throw pins at the rotating wheel in Pin Spin ! Check the color of the next pin and wait for the matching section to come around. Time the throw so it lands in that segment, then get ready to do the same for the next color.

pages.title: Funny Cooking Camp
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help hungry mice make a meal outdoors in Funny Cooking Camp. Build a clay oven and collect the things you need for the grill. Use the oven to bake pizza, then grill satays to finish cooking at the campsite.

pages.title: Puzzling
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Drag pegs to stretch strings into pictures in Puzzling. Look at the design and decide which way to pull each part of the string to make the outline. Work through shapes such as cats, flowers, and rockets as the puzzles change.

pages.title: Ninja Legend
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Aim a weapon at enemies in Ninja Legend. Look at where each target is standing and adjust your aim before letting the attack go. Keep checking the next position as the enemies change and try to take them down quickly.

pages.title: Turn Left
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Find a safe gap to turn left in Turn Left. Watch the vehicles going straight and judge when there’s room for your car to cross. Wait for a bigger opening when traffic is close together, then send the next car through without a collision.

pages.title: Oil Tycoon 2
pages.creator: Holy Cow Studio
pages.description: Build an oil business from scratch in Oil Tycoon 2. Manage your wells, earn profits, and distribute oil to different countries as the operation grows. Put the earnings back into the business and expand beyond the wells you started with.

pages.title: Straw Hat Samurai 2
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Draw lines to slash enemies or jump between platforms in Straw Hat Samurai 2. Start a slash beneath an enemy to launch it for an air combo, and use shunpo when a boss is vulnerable. Start a jump line at the samurai’s current position to reach the next platform.

pages.title: Santa Rescue
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Move pins to help Santa collect presents in Santa Rescue. Look at what each pin is holding back and decide which one should go first. Find a way to free Santa and gather the gifts as you work through all 30 puzzles.

pages.title: Mr Autogun Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Shoot through robots and obstacles in Mr Autogun Online. Jump over spikes and gaps, use the sling to reach enemies, and break boxes for loot to upgrade your guns. Face bosses as you work your way through more than 30 levels.

pages.title: Vex 6
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Jump and slide through nine acts and nine harder versions in Vex 6. Make it through the Vexation stage at the end of each act and collect coins to unlock skins. Return for daily tasks or try the bonus level to earn extra coins.

pages.title: Arkadium's Ballistic
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Drag to aim a volley in Arkadium's Ballistic. Choose an angle that lets the balls hit several tiles before they return. Keep clearing tiles as they pile up, because the game ends when one reaches the bottom row.

pages.title: Merge To Million
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Select a numbered block and place it beside one with the same value to merge them in Merge To Million. Start with small values and set up combinations that help you reach larger numbers. Use the six kinds of power-ups to make room or continue a chain as you work toward one million.

pages.title: Lows Adventures 2
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Find five coins to unlock the trophy in each stage of Lows Adventures 2. Look for coins hidden off the main route and use the platforms to reach them. Work through 31 levels and take on the boss after guiding Low through the adventure.

pages.title: Hidden Wrench In Trucks
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find ten hidden wrenches in each scene in Hidden Wrench In Trucks. Search the trucks and the surrounding details before time runs out. Each of the six levels gives you ten seconds less than the previous one, so look carefully without lingering too long in one spot.

pages.title: GT Ghost Racing
pages.creator: RodaGames
pages.description: Race against the recorded runs of other drivers in GT Ghost Racing. Pick a vehicle and learn the turns as you race through winter, night, and neon tracks. Chase the ghosts and collect stars as you work on a faster run.

pages.title: Philatelic Escape Fauna Album
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Get inside an apartment in Philatelic Escape Fauna Album. Look through the rooms for ten hidden stamps and their album, and use clues in the surroundings to crack passwords or open locked doors. Check small details when a puzzle leaves you unsure where to look next.

pages.title: Jail Breaker
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Choose the right item for each situation in Jail Breaker. Read the prompt and decide what might help the prisoner get past the problem. Keep making choices as new obstacles come up and try to get him through the escape.

pages.title: Kittens Jigsaw
pages.creator: 4GameGround
pages.description: Piece together pictures of kittens in Kittens Jigsaw. Choose a difficulty and look for fur markings or background details that continue across neighboring pieces. Finish one picture and choose another kitten when you’re ready to try a new puzzle.

pages.title: Coloring Mees Kees
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Color illustrations of Mees Kees in Coloring Mees Kees. Draw freely, use the mode that keeps your colors within the lines, or fill an area automatically. Download and print a page if you want to finish the picture on paper.

pages.title: Christmas Imposter Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Gather presents in Christmas Imposter Run while steering around obstacles. Look for gnomes as well as gifts, because collecting enough of them gives you a shield. Keep watching the route and choose when to move toward a pickup.

pages.title: Shooter Rush
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Move around the field and shoot approaching enemies in Shooter Rush. Leave yourself room to maneuver as they close in and keep firing into the groups. Trigger fire mode when it becomes available to clear several enemies at once.

pages.title: Aviation Art Air Combat Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild six air combat illustrations in Aviation Art Air Combat Puzzle. Choose 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces for each image. Follow the outlines of the aircraft and the colors in the sky to work out where neighboring pieces belong.

pages.title: Impossible Army Tank Driving Simulator Tracks
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive a tank along dangerous routes in Impossible Army Tank Driving Simulator Tracks. Keep it lined up on the track and use missiles or bombs to destroy obstacles. Watch the next section before moving forward so you can decide when to drive and when to fire.

pages.title: Block Jewel Puzzle
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Fit blocks into the grid in Block Jewel Puzzle. Complete a row or column to clear it, then use the space for your next pieces. Think about where a larger shape can go before filling the gaps around it, and see how high you can score.

pages.title: Ball Rotate
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Rotate a maze to move the balls in Ball Rotate. Watch where gravity takes them as you turn the layout, then adjust the angle to guide them around barriers. Get the balls out of the maze and into the pipe below to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Swords of Brim
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Run through the invading Goons in Swords of Brim. Jump, slide, and strike as enemies and obstacles come into view. Collect gold coins along the way and spend them on upgrades for your heroes before going back out to fight.

pages.title: Pensive Girl Escape
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Search a house for a trapped girl in Pensive Girl Escape. Click the objects around you to find clues and see what they unlock. Use the things you discover to solve the puzzles and find a way to get the girl out.

pages.title: Turbo Drift
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Earn points by holding drifts in Turbo Drift. Build up speed before a corner, then steer into a slide and keep control as the car moves sideways. Work toward the target score and adjust your approach when a turn cuts a drift short.

pages.title: King War IO
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Build an empire and defend it from zombies in King War IO. Set up buildings, improve them with upgrades, and use your archer to fight off the waves. Decide where to put your resources as the attacks keep coming.

pages.title: Kara Food Drop
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Guide a chicken across the ground in Kara Food Drop. Move underneath falling food to eat it, but watch for other objects mixed in with the drops. Keep collecting food while staying out of the way of anything that could end the run.

pages.title: Cartoon Candy Deluxe
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Connect matching sweets in Cartoon Candy Deluxe. Look for three or more candies with the same shape and color, then trace a longer chain if you can. The round starts with 30 seconds, and bigger matches add time and help you score more.

pages.title: Sky Warrior 2 Invasion
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Fight enemy planes in Sky Warrior 2 Invasion. Steer through the action and collect fuel, ammunition, missiles, and other pickups to keep the aircraft going. Watch for stars and upgrades while you clear enemy fighters from your path.

pages.title: Flipper Dunk
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Use flippers to launch the ball toward the basket in Flipper Dunk. Time each hit so the ball goes up instead of slipping past the flippers. Keep it in play and score as many points as you can before time runs out.

pages.title: Glam Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Put together looks for virtual models in Glam Dress Up. Browse the dresses and choose hairstyles that fit the outfits you have in mind. Try different combinations on the models, from a more understated look to something ready for a fashion spread.

pages.title: Vertical Multi car Suv Parking
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Guide an SUV into tight spaces in Vertical Multi car Suv Parking. Look at the space and the nearby obstacles before you turn in. Give the vehicle room to straighten out and practice getting it lined up in the narrow parking areas.

pages.title: Stunt Crash 4 fun
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Build up speed in a stunt car and see if you can carry it around the oversized loops. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys. Use B for the handbrake, V to change the camera, and Space to restart a run.

pages.title: Prison Escape
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Guide a prisoner through a series of rooms using the arrow keys. Watch where the guards patrol before stepping into their path, and pick up keys in the rooms that have them. Work your way to the exit to advance to the next level.

pages.title: Santa Airlines
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fly Santa’s Skybus DEC25 in Santa Airlines. Steer around clouds, pick up presents and boosters, and look out for children to rescue along the route. Try the tutorial to get used to the controls before taking Santa on a longer flight.

pages.title: Turkey Cake Pops
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Make a Thanksgiving treat in Turkey Cake Pops. Gather the ingredients and follow the recipe to prepare the chocolate and strawberry cake pops. Work through the steps until the pops are ready and have the look of little turkeys.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Thanksgiving Makeover
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Get Baby Hazel ready for Thanksgiving in Baby Hazel Thanksgiving Makeover. Choose a festive outfit and apply her makeup while her mother is busy with preparations. Finish with jewelry and hair accessories that go with the clothes you’ve picked.

pages.title: Spinning Block
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Drop spinning blocks onto a tower in Spinning Block. Wait until each piece is horizontal before releasing it, and try to line it up with the floor below. Misaligned blocks make the tower less stable, so take care as you build higher.

pages.title: Crazy Bouncing
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Bounce from platform to platform in Crazy Bouncing. Look at where the ball is headed and stay away from the spikes as you aim for a safe landing. Keep the bounces going and see whether you can beat your previous score.

pages.title: Mini Monster Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Line up three or more matching monsters in Mini Monster Match 3. Look for groups that will earn points and keep an eye on the meter at the left. The game ends if it drops too low, so plan another match as the pieces settle.

pages.title: Bucket Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Get a ball into a bucket in Bucket Ball. Move or flip the objects in the way and see how they change the ball’s route. Work out which parts of the contraption need to move before letting the ball drop toward the bucket.

pages.title: The Bridges
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Keep a walking character on a safe route by clicking to turn the bridges. Line up the next section before the character steps off the edge. Collect coins as you go and spend them on other characters to take across the bridges.

pages.title: BTS Aligator Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose an alligator picture in BTS Aligator Coloring and fill it with colors from the palette. Try different shades on the animal and the details around it, then move on to another drawing. Use a new combination whenever you want to change the look of the page.

pages.title: Collect More Candy
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pick up as many sweets as you can in Collect More Candy. Watch for the next candy and collect it before the timer runs out. Keep your attention on the play area and see how much you can gather before the round ends.

pages.title: Frontline Commando Mission 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Take on enemy fighters in Frontline Commando Mission 3D. Look for a clear shot as you move through the combat area, then use your weapon to take out opponents. Stay ready for the next threat as you work through the mission.

pages.title: Captain Minecraft
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Run through a blocky obstacle course with a zombie chasing close behind. Dodge the hazards in your path and time your jumps to keep the run going. Pick up coins along the way while trying to stay ahead of the zombie for as long as you can.

pages.title: Gold Miner Bros
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Work together to gather gold and diamonds in Gold Miner Bros. Reach the targets that open the next mines, and use supplies from the shop, such as boosters and dynamite, to deal with traps. Take the brothers through all 36 levels as the jobs get tougher.

pages.title: Cannon Basketball 4
pages.creator: Nepix
pages.description: Fire basketballs from a cannon in Cannon Basketball 4. Aim around walls or shoot through breakable barriers to open a path to the basket. Watch where each ball lands and change the angle when you need to reach a different part of the puzzle.

pages.title: Princess Romantic Gataway
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose a destination for Anna and Kristoff in Princess Romantic Gataway. Help them pack for the trip, then pick outfits for both characters once they arrive. Try a different look to suit the location you’ve chosen in the United States, Europe, or Africa.

pages.title: Princess Royal Contest
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress the princesses for the annual ball in Princess Royal Contest Play Now. Browse the dresses, flowers, and other accessories for each guest. Put together a look for your favorite princess before she takes part in the royal event.

pages.title: Moto Fury
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Ride through highway traffic in Moto Fury. Overtake vehicles and keep the bike under control as the speed rises. Earn cash from your runs, then spend it on another motorcycle and see how far you can go without crashing.

pages.title: 3 Minute Adventure
pages.creator: Next Realm Games
pages.description: Choose what to do in a short interactive story in 3 Minute Adventure. Get equipment, face a dragon, and talk to a princess as the adventure unfolds. Try a different choice on another run to see where it takes you.

pages.title: Muffins Memory Match
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Turn over cards and remember their pictures in Muffins Memory Match. Find the identical pairs and clear the board. Choose Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert to change the challenge and see how well you remember where the pictures are.

pages.title: Master of Runes
pages.creator: HongByte
pages.description: Clear falling runes by clicking or tapping the point where runes of the same color intersect. Watch the line at the bottom of the board and make matches before the runes reach it. Score enough points to advance to the next level.

pages.title: Flower Blast
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Burst flowers to set off chain reactions in Flower Blast. Look for the flower that will reach the others and use each burst to clear more of the board. Remove every flower to advance through the game’s 400 levels.

pages.title: Captain Hangman
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guess hidden words aboard a pirate ship in Captain Hangman. Pick letters to reveal parts of the word and use those clues before making your next guess. Keep solving words to win your freedom and avoid becoming a meal for the sharks.

pages.title: Horse Care and Riding
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Look after a stallion in Horse Care and Riding. Go through the care routine and choose how to dress for the outing. Once the horse and rider are ready, take the horse out for the riding activity.

pages.title: Princess Donuts Shop 2
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare doughnuts for customers in Princess Donuts Shop 2. Work through the cooking steps with the princess, then choose candy, toppings, and fruit to decorate each one. Try a new combination when you want the next doughnut to look different.

pages.title: Princess Driver Quiz
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Answer questions about your driving style in Princess Driver Quiz. Pick the options that fit you best and see what kind of driver the quiz says you are. Afterward, choose decorations and accessories for the car’s dashboard.

pages.title: Magic Stones
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Match three or more gems of the same color in Magic Stones. Look for large groups to earn experience and unlock special powers. A group of at least 15 can earn bombs or medallions, so check whether your next move can help you build a bigger match.

pages.title: Gold Mine Strike
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Throw pickaxes at groups of matching blocks in Gold Mine Strike. Clear the blocks as they approach and use power-ups when you need help making space. Spend the gold you collect on improving your power-ups before the next run.

pages.title: Jewel Burst
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Collect gems from the stars in Jewel Burst. Look for sets of three or more identical jewels and bring them together to clear a group. Check the board again after each match and work through the puzzles one combination at a time.

pages.title: Princesses Dreamy Dress!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give the princesses new looks in Princesses Dreamy Dress! Browse the outfits for each character and decide which pieces fit the style you want. Try different choices as you work through the group and give each princess a look of her own.

pages.title: Ice Princess Halloween Costumes
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Put together a costume in Ice Princess Halloween Costumes. Dress the princess as a cat, unicorn, witch, or scarecrow, or mix pieces from different looks. Finish with makeup and accessories that go with the outfit you’ve created.
